Dear Sir/Madam, We are thankful for the interest and confidence shown towards our services, with reference to the subject inquiry, please do find our competitive proposal for the same as follows;
WATER TANK CLEANING AND DISINFECTION SCOPE OF WORK

WATER TANK CLEANING AND DISINFECTION SCOPE OF WORK

Aaban carry out all workers strictly in accordance with the highest safety standards. All our technicians are trained in all aspects of Safety to Ensure that accidents do not occurs and they are well supervised to ensure that operation must be smooth. All Our technicians have all the required PPEs such as 3M Respiratory mask, goggles, gloves, safety shoes, safety belts and all instruments for this process.

Scope of Work

Our process starts with the deep Cleaning of the entire Water Tank., Draining out the Existing Water, Cleaning the interior Tanks, Disinfection, Washing and Flushing the Tanks, Refilling the Tanks with Fresh Water and Lab Testing for Tanks.

Terms & Conditions:-

Customers Responsibilities

1.Tanks will be drained by client prior to scheduled arrival of Cleaning Terms or provide us schedule water tank 05 % to 10 % of water level or empty tank.

2.Use of your 220 volts single-phase electricity supply & water supply 60 litter/min near working location.

3.Work Permit to be Prepared in advance.

4.Clients to ensure proper access for all available Units.

5.Clients to shall arrange all the passes and permits required, by our vehicle and operator in the service location or to park the vehicle during service time.

6.Safe Storage for Our Equipment’s until completion of Work

7.Waste Disposal facility for debris removed.

8.Authorized Person / Staff should be there to verification & completion Report upon completion of each area.

9.The Operator will drain leftover Water below suction level in the Tanks in the Client’s drainage system.

Contract Terms and Conditions:

As per Ajman Municipality guidelines, the rooftop tank should be cleaned only after cleaning the main supply tank, if client prefers only to clean rooftop tank and take the sample, if sample gets positive Aaban will not take any responsibility for re-cleaning or re-sampling.

Payment Terms :

Payments 50 % in advance and 50 % after 6 months for contract, if one time 50% in advance and 50 % after completion of work, payable by cash, cheque or Bank Transfer. Cheque made in favor to Aaban Classic Building Cleaning LLC.

The First Party and The Second Party have agreed for Termite Control Agreement on following terms and conditions:

Article - 1: The Scope of Work:

1. Operations will be carried out as per Ajman Municipality stated / approved procedures and terms and conditions for Pre-Construction Termite control strategies.

Stage 1: PCC & RCC.

Stage 2: Vertical and Horizontal inside the tie beams

Stage 3: Vertical and Horizontal outside the tie beams

Article 3- Terms of Payment :

1. Payment will be charged as treatment is completed with 5% VAT.

Article 4- Materials & Methods :

1. All services will be provided as per Ajman Municipality-approved procedures.

2. All equipment and terms of control treatments will be according to the standards set by the Municipality.

3. At least one day before first party will inform to the second for treatment with mutual understanding and first part will also arrange a representative for collaboration.

4. Onsite Electricity and Water availability will be arranged / confirmed by the second party.

5. The second part will provide a polythene sheet as per the required length and quality.

6.  The Second Party will provide access to the First Party to the areas to be serviced.

Article 5- Warranty Certificate :

1.   Aaban Company will provide a TEN-YEAR WARRANTY for the treated areas as per scope of treatment & service area reports.

2.  Payment amount will be charged at the rate given per square meter.

3.  During warranty period services will be served without any cost.

4.   Warranty will be given for the treated area / place only.
